title: Mark editable-installed plugins for assertion rewriting

comments.author: RonnyPfannschmidt
comments.body:
potential edge-case - this might mark all of a set of namespace packages intead of just the one with the plugin

i'like to see this validated, but i recon its pretty tricky to create the conditions
comments.label: issue
comments.rationale: Edge case: taking the top-level package of each entry point marks every package in a shared namespace for assertion rewriting, not just the plugin.
